headline.purpose: Page titles via PageHeader — max 24px on ops pages.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary actions — New Permit, Sign in.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0f766e; color: #f7fafa; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0d6560; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f766e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Link Active
components.description: Active sidebar item with inset accent edge.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: #e6f3f2; color: #1a2e2e; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 0 #0f766e; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field with accent focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #1a2e2e; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d4dede; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f766e; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #0f766e; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5c6f6f; }

narrative.overview: Warm integrated operations workspace with Permit Teal accent and Geist typography. App shell replaces legacy gray-900 sidebar and blue-600 defaults.

rules.name: The Restrained Warmth Rule
rules.body: Tinted neutrals carry the interface; accent on ≤10% of screen.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces flat at rest; tonal steps not shadows.

rules.name: The Operational Type Rule
rules.body: No display clamp heroes on ops pages.

dos: Do use CSS variables from globals.css
Do keep nav labels visible on mobile
Do use PageHeader for page titles
donts: Don't use gray-900 sidebar or blue-600 accent
Don't use generic KPI card grids as default dashboard
Don't duplicate user info in sidebar and header
